verdict.rationale: Homebrew's own Brewfile feature encodes desired environment state declaratively. The docs present it as a file to commit to a project repository, and `brew bundle dump` snapshots installed state into it, so this automation can be versioned and reviewed through the repo. However, `brew bundle check`/`install` only converge to the current file, and community reports describe no package rollback mechanism: users fall back to disabling cleanup to keep old versions, and say upgrades could not be pinned. missing for 10: first-party rollback to prior versions, version pinning in Brewfiles, built-in review or diff of automation changes, independent corroboration of versioned-automation workflows.
